questions: Q1: What commands are needed and what server endpoints do they use?
Q2: How should file content be sent to the server — multipart or JSON body?
Q3: How does the iterate command handle optimistic concurrency (Finding #6)?
Q4: Which commands require admin access (Finding #7)?
Q5: How is manual reconcile exposed via CLI (Finding #4)?

answers.answer: Five commands (revised from 4): create (POST /library/items, new), iterate (POST /library/items/:id/iterate, new), publish (POST /library/items/:id/publish, existing), delete (DELETE /library/items/:id, existing), reconcile (POST /admin/library/reconcile, new — Finding #4). Publish, delete, and reconcile require admin role (Finding #7).
evidence: src/library/index.ts: switch cases for list, show, comments only — no create/iterate/publish/delete/reconcile
api.ts lines 413-414: POST publish and DELETE endpoints exist
Finding #4: 'hlx library reconcile' must be in MVP

answers.answer: JSON body with content as a string field. Report files are typically <1MB text. Aligns with existing hxFetch pattern.
evidence: src/lib/http.ts: hxFetch sends JSON bodies (Content-Type: application/json)
No existing multipart upload pattern in the CLI

answers.answer: Iterate fetches the current item to obtain commitSha, then sends it as baseCommitSha in the POST body. On 409 Conflict, displays clear error guiding user to reload and retry.
evidence: Finding #6: iterate requires baseCommitSha to prevent lost updates
Server API returns 409 Conflict with latestCommitSha on stale write

answers.answer: Publish, delete, and reconcile require admin role. On 403 from server, CLI displays 'Admin access required' error.
evidence: Finding #7: publish and delete gated behind requireAdmin
Finding #4: reconcile is an admin endpoint

answers.answer: hlx library reconcile calls POST /api/admin/library/reconcile (requireAdmin). Displays reconciled/skipped/errored counts. This is the missed-webhook recovery valve moved from Round 2 to MVP.
evidence: Finding #4: manual reconcile must be in MVP, not deferred to Round 2

statement: CLI adds 5 thin-client commands (create, iterate, publish, delete, reconcile) over server API endpoints. Key revisions from iteration 1: iterate fetches commitSha and sends baseCommitSha for optimistic concurrency (F6), publish/delete/reconcile require admin (F7/F4), reconcile command added in MVP (F4), acceptance test requires re-versioning RSH-667/RSH-688 via iterate (F14).
